checklist.text: It builds (not compiled; read and traced by hand)
Drag the ring slowly and let go within about 2 notches short of N, W, S or E: it settles on the letter
Let go just past a letter (half a notch): it pulls back onto it
A fast flick still coasts past letters and stops on an ordinary notch elsewhere; no jitter while settling
Does it feel too sticky? Tune CompassAhead / CompassBehind in Dial.cs

description: The ring leans toward the compass points. When it slows down it settles on N/W/S/E if it would stop within 2 notches (20 degrees) short of one or half a notch past it. Side effect: the notch right next to a letter can only be reached by turning away from the letter. Session 42. Files: `Dial.cs`, `GameEngine.cs` (version).
title: 5.17 Ring pulls toward N/W/E/S
